title: Vibe Coding Anomaly: flutter_secure_storage Declared in pubspec.yaml With Zero Imports in lib/
description: The project declares `flutter_secure_storage` in `pubspec.yaml` dependencies (often after an AI prompt to 'make storage secure'), but zero Dart files in `lib/` ever import or invoke it, leaving all runtime storage calls on unencrypted legacy mechanisms.
attack_vector: Developers and superficial dependency scanners assume credentials are encrypted at rest because `flutter_secure_storage` appears in `pubspec.yaml`, while actual tokens remain exposed in cleartext storage.
fix_rationale: Import `package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart` in the storage service layer and verify that all sensitive read/write call sites actively invoke `FlutterSecureStorage`.
